CLAIM: A fixed-model outer research loop can improve an inner agent harness under a fixed cost budget, with gains that survive held-out evaluation and with reward-hacking resistance measured outside the visible optimization signal.
BASELINE: research-design-loop 0.3.0 + research donor gate/field compiler before any donor-derived harness mutation
FALSIFIER: At fixed model/tool budget, the donor-derived harness change does not improve independent held-out repo acceptance, or improves only the development signal while held-out invariants regress.
FIXED: model/version; tool set; development/held-out fixture identities; compute/time cap; native host authority; FIELD egress precedence
MUTATED: one bounded research harness, prompt, reducer, or verification-policy delta only
DEV_METRIC: development fixtures visible to the candidate loop; never used as final acceptance
HELD_OUT: independent repo fixtures withheld from tuning and used only for acceptance
REWARD_HACK_CHECK: compare visible/development success with independent held-out host invariants; self-critic score cannot accept its own mutation
INVARIANT: source identity, host authority, RETURN, and FIELD egress precedence remain unchanged by the donor-derived mutation
NON_TRANSFER: claims of general recursive self-improvement beyond the reproduced bounded mechanism
ambient autonomous rewriting of production code

REPLICA.observable: A donor-derived bounded harness/evaluation change must outperform or reject more false-positive development wins than the baseline on independent held-out repo fixtures at the same budget.

source_observables: 100 outer-loop harness rewrites under a fixed evaluation protocol
held-out benchmark evaluation beyond the optimization tasks
